meaning:
θύελλα, -ης, ἡ
(θύω), [in LXX Deu.4:11 5:22 (עֲרָפֶל), Exo.10:22 * ;] (poët. in cl.),
a hurricane, cyclone, whirlwind: Heb.12:18.†
SYN.: λαίλαψ (which see) (AS)

elsewhere.note: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
